name: Iinchou no Iinari Kyoushi
original_name: 委員長のいいなり教師
source: My teacher just made the biggest mistake of his life. I caught him looking at me lewdly, so I am going to humiliate him.
translation: My teacher just made the biggest mistake of his life. I caught him looking at me lewdly, so I am going to humiliate him.
